Imagine a job where you stay fit, earn solid pay, and still have time for yourself later in the day.

Early hours, strong teamwork, and clear routines make this job ideal for people who enjoy hands‑on work and visible results. 
As a Logistic Worker, you will be responsible for the following activities: 
 - Scanning & labeling shipments; - Sorting packages for delivery; - Keeping the warehouse organized. 
Worktimes/days and hours per week: 
You start early and finish early, perfect if you enjoy having your afternoons free. 
Shifts: 05:00-10:00 or 05:00-13:00 (you can choose). If you an experienced Logistic Worker, you have an option to start at 06:00 hours. 
Job requirements: 
 - Own transportation (public transport is not an option); - Parttime availability for at a minimum of 3 days per week. - Able to obtain a VOG and able to do a certification before starting; - Physically fit and comfortable with active work; - You speak Dutch and/or English. 
Conditions for our Logistic worker: 
 - €15.16 gross per hour; - Travel reimbursement: €0.23 per km; - Shift bonus: 130% pay between 00:00 and 06:00; - Possibility of a permanent contract; - Air Freight Training (strong addition to your CV).

 Your mission 
 As a Technical Consultant, you translate client requests into technical specifications. Based on these specifications, you create overviews, reports, and/or dashboards for end users and/or managers to meet their needs. In addition, you automate work processes using SQL queries. You ask probing questions, think along with the client, identify the actual information needs, and ensure that the right (management) information can be extracted from myneva. You are responsible for delivering robust technical solutions from myneva. 
Clients rely on you because of your subject matter expertise, sense of responsibility, and ability to adapt quickly. You know how to understand client needs so that you can translate them into the myneva software. You advise, guide, and support clients in setting up our Electronic Client File (ECD). 
You work independently with the client or in a project team with other consultants and/or specialists. You are innovative and solution-oriented. You do all of this effortlessly thanks to your commitment, curiosity, and natural talent for setting the right priorities.
